channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Series of new car models to hit Vietnam
item.description: Vietnam’s automotive market is poised for a vibrant year in 2026 as a wave of new models prepares to enter the market, including hybrid and electric vehicles (EVs).

item.title: Young brain-dead donor saves 4 lives during Tet transplant surgeries in Vietnam
item.description: A 21-year-old man has saved four patients through organ donation after brain death, following a series of transplant surgeries performed during the 2026 Lunar New Year (Tet) holiday at Viet Duc Friendship Hospital in Hanoi.

item.title: Vietnam ministry orders careful review of $9bn Ho Chi Minh City-Can Tho railway project
item.description: The Vietnamese Ministry of Construction has urged deeper analysis of the proposed Ho Chi Minh City-Can Tho railway, whose projected investment is about US$9 billion, to ensure investment efficiency and smooth implementation, Deputy Minister Bui Xuan Dung said at a recent meeting on the project’s pre-feasibility study.

item.title: Vietnam’s THACO opens 3 factories worth $70mn, ships 500 containers of goods
item.description: Vietnamese conglomerate Truong Hai Group Corporation (THACO) on Monday inaugurated three new factories in Da Nang with a combined investment of US$70 million, and shipped nearly 500 containers of goods to international markets.

item.title: Canadian officials to meet with OpenAI safety team after school shooting
item.description: TORONTO - Canada summoned top officials from OpenAI for a meeting about the company's safety protocols, a Canadian official said on Monday, after the ChatGPT maker said it did not reach out to police about an account it banned last year belonging to mass shooter Jesse Van Rootselaar.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City sees 43% drop in road traffic deaths during 2026 Tet holiday
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City recorded a 43-percent year-on-year decline in road traffic fatalities during the nine-day Lunar New Year (Tet) holiday from February 14 to 22, local authorities said on Monday.

item.title: $11.5 plate of 6 prawns in Vietnam’s Phu Quoc draws online attention to pricing
item.description: A plate of six tiger prawns priced at VND300,000 (US$11.5) has sparked reactions after a visitor to Phu Quoc Special Zone in An Giang Province, southern Vietnam complained online on Sunday that the dish was overpriced and of poor quality.

item.title: Vietnam’s Party chief sends congratulations to Kim Jong Un on re-election
item.description: Vietnamese Party General Secretary To Lam on Monday sent a congratulatory message to General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Kim Jong Un on his re-election as the WPK chief at the ninth Party Congress.

item.title: Air tickets to Ho Chi Minh City remain scarce, expensive after Tet
item.description: Air tickets from northern and central Vietnam to Ho Chi Minh City, the southern economic hub, have remained in short supply, with prices staying high since the end of the Tet (Lunar New Year) holiday.
